extraction_scope.overclaim_guard: No protein synthesis/translation mechanism is asserted; the prior framework note was replaced with membrane-binding/permeabilization claims only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AP3 and derivative peptides bind lipid vesicles as measured by tryptophan fluorescence intensity changes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding is mechanistic context and does not alone establish antimicrobial activity.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Full-length peptides adopt helical conformations in lipid vesicles by circular dichroism, while truncated peptides differ in helical character.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Secondary structure supports structure-activity interpretation but is not a killing mechanism by itself.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Full-length AP peptides cause dose-dependent calcein leakage from 75:25 PC:PG vesicles; truncated peptides show minimal leakage at tested concentrations.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model-vesicle permeabilization supports membrane-disruption mechanism but does not specify a pore architecture.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Bacterial outer and inner membrane permeabilization assays in E. coli support membrane permeabilization as the activity-linked phenotype.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AP3 and derivative peptides tested in E. coli D31 permeabilization assays
